misconception: Defend is spent by the first Ravage in a land; a second Ravage there that turn is not reduced.
rulebook: FAQ .7w4geew "Defend applies each time the Invaders deal Damage in a land - it isn't 'used up' in the first Ravage."

edits.find: defend L N / defend-total L N
edits.replace:
#acc defend-used : land
damage-land L D, +defend-spent L
defend-spent L / defend-used L
defend L N, not defend-used L / defend-total L N

notes: Spent forever rather than per turn; the scenario has only one turn. Uses a + fact because damage-land has ended by the next Ravage, and #acc reads only live tuples.
